description: Linked decisions (L2, 4.1.0). An accepted decision with applies-to binds what it names as a constraint does, and only by applies-to: a section or query read of R1 carries D2, while a proposed decision that names R1 (D3), an accepted decision with no applies-to (D4) and a superseded one (D1) stay out. A read that does not show R1 does not carry D2. A linked decision whose target names no block is unplaced: shown in every read, and the read is incomplete in its resolution part.

requests.name: section Cutover carries the accepted decision that names R1
section Other does not carry D2, because it does not show R1
query R1 with the contract carries D2 as the section read does
a linked decision with a mistyped target is shown in every read and makes it incomplete
